cover.title: The bond market just hit a [[24-YEAR]] high

slides.line: Oil spiked on Iran fears. Inflation fears pushed yields up.
10-year slid below 5% as a tech selloff sent money into Treasuries.

caption:
The bond market just hit its highest yields in 24 years. 📈

The US 30-year hit 5.59% on Sept 29, the highest since 2002. This week the 10-year slid back below 5%.
